MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT CONCAT( VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.flavor__c, ' | ', VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.nicotine_level__c ) AS flavor_nicotine_combo__c, COUNT(*) AS combo_count__c FROM VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm LEFT JOIN Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm ON VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.flavor__c = Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.flavor__c AND VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.nicotine_level__c = Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.nicotine_level__c WHERE VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.manufacturer__c NOT IN ('NATIONAL TOBACCO COMPANY', 'SWEDISH MATCH') AND VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.flavor__c <> 'Other' AND VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.nicotine_level__c NOT IN ('UNKNOWN', 'NA') AND VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.brand_family__c NOT IN ('ZYN (OST)', 'FRE (OST)') AND Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.flavor__c IS NULL GROUP BY CONCAT( VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.flavor__c, ' | ', VOLUME_ENRICHED_TRIMMED__dlm.nicotine_level__c )
